bulkSchema.title: Oak Curriculum API Bulk Export Schema

sequenceSlug.description: Slug for the subject sequence collection (e.g., 'french-primary').

sequence.description: Ordered list of units for the subject sequence.

ks4Options.description: Available KS4 options for the subject (e.g., exam boards or pathways).

lessons.description: Published lessons available for the subject, across units (unitLessons with state != 'published' are excluded).

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical URL for the unit, pointing back to the main Oak National web resource.

threads.description: Thread tags that categorise unit content.

priorKnowledgeRequirements.description: Prior knowledge statements required for the unit.

nationalCurriculumContent.description: National curriculum references covered by the unit.

anyOf.description: This only applies to Physical Education (primary) where swimming is classed as all years.

pathway.description: Pathway identifier for the unit (e.g., 'GCSE' or 'Core' for KS4 units).

pathwaySlug.description: Pathway slug for the unit (e.g., 'gcse' or 'core' for KS4 units).

whyThisWhyNow.description: Rationale for sequence timing and unit placement.

unitOptionGroup.description: If the unit is a unit variant, then this field indicates the option group it belongs to (e.g., 'life-in-a-capital-city-london-cardiff').

examSubjects.description: Exam subjects relevant to the unit (typically secondary).

unitLessons.description: Lessons that belong to the unit in teaching order.

lessonSlug.description: Slug identifier for the lesson (must exist in lessons[] when state is 'published').

lessonOrder.description: Order of the lesson within the unit.

state.description: Publication state for the lesson (only 'published' lessons appear in lessons[]).

oakUrl.description: Direct URL for the lesson on the Oak National Academy website.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical URL for the lesson, pointing back to the main Oak National web resource.

unitSlug.description: Slug identifier of the unit this lesson belongs to.

unitTitle.description: Title of the unit this lesson belongs to.

lessonKeywords.description: Keywords used to index or describe the lesson.

keyLearningPoints.description: Key learning points for the lesson.

contentGuidance.description: Additional content guidance; may be null when not provided.

downloadsavailable.description: Whether downloads are available for the lesson.

restricted.description: Whether the lesson is restricted or highly restricted, this means access to the assets (such as videos, transcripts, quizzes, etc) is prevented.

supervisionLevel.description: Supervision requirement; may be null when not provided.

transcript_sentences.description: Transcript in sentence form; may be null when not provided.

transcript_vtt.description: Transcript in VTT format; may be null when not provided.

keyLearningPoint.description: A single key learning point statement.

response.description: Recommended response to address the misconception.

examBoardSlug.description: KS4 option slug (exam board or pathway).

examBoardTitle.description: KS4 option title (exam board or pathway).

yearSlug.description: Slug for the academic year or band.

lessonKeywords.description: In language, blending means to join the beginning of one word with the end of another to create a new word.
Compounds are words that are formed by combining two existing words together.
An acronym is a word formed by combining the first letter of each word in a name or phrase (e.g. ASAP).
